title: Day 6 engineering reference topology — not a final BOM or selected architecture

modules.label: Shared wrist module
notes: Shared resource identities and allocation remain open; each must be counted once.

modules.label: Shared chest module
notes: ECG/BioZ electrode sharing is not assumed until a montage is validated.

modules.label: Intermittent frontal EEG module
notes: Electrode count, montage, and session schedule remain open.

modules.label: Experimental leg BioZ module
notes: Electrode topology and operating schedule remain open.

modules.label: Second PPG-site evaluation branch
notes: One additional optical site is fixed; shared, tethered, or standalone electronics remain unresolved.

components.label: Wrist IMU
components.operating_schedule: Continuous and synchronized with PPG during HR inference.

hardware_identity.device_class: wearable six-axis IMU used in accelerometer-only mode
hardware_identity.rationale: Wearable-focused digital IMU with 16-bit accelerometer and SPI/I2C; representative identity is independent of the positive HR result.
exclusions: The PPG-DaLiA checkpoint was trained on Empatica E4 32 Hz acceleration, not BMI270 output.

components.label: Second physical PPG site
components.physical_sensing_site: one added proximal phalanx optical site
components.operating_schedule: Continuous in the frozen experiment; deployable schedule open.

hardware_identity.device_class: additional wearable optical interface and dual-channel-capable AFE class
hardware_identity.rationale: The class can support multiple LED drivers and two optical receivers, but the experiment's exact six-channel hardware is not a final device design.
exclusions: Does not establish whether electronics are shared, tethered, or a standalone module.

components.label: Wrist PPG
components.operating_schedule: Continuous while HR inference is active.

hardware_identity.rationale: Provides wearable PPG readout, 19-bit conversion, LED drivers, FIFO, and SPI; final emitters, detectors, and optical stack remain open.
exclusions: Not a complete optical module or final PPG hardware identity.

components.label: Chest ECG
components.operating_schedule: Continuous reference acquisition; target sufficiency unvalidated.

contact_burden.contact_type: electrode interface, type and count open

hardware_identity.rationale: Portable biopotential AFE with two channels, respiration capability, and a published per-channel power point.
exclusions: Electrode topology and diagnostic/clinical performance are not frozen.

components.label: Thoracic BioZ / ICG
components.operating_schedule: Intermittent candidate; cadence and duration open.

contact_burden.contact_type: electrode interface; sharing with ECG unresolved

hardware_identity.rationale: Manufacturer explicitly supports body/skin impedance and sequenced duty cycling; measurement settings remain open.
exclusions: The low-power potentiostat current is not used as active BioZ measurement power.

components.label: Skin temperature
components.operating_schedule: One conversion per second reference schedule.

contact_burden.contact_type: thermal path within existing wrist interface

hardware_identity.rationale: Low-power I2C device with a documented 1 Hz current point; thermal coupling and physiological validity remain separate design questions.
exclusions: Component accuracy is not evidence of validated skin-temperature target performance.

hardware_identity.rationale: Documented low-current, continuous/single-shot I2C light sensing; final sample interval and optical window remain open.
exclusions: Automotive qualification is not required or claimed for the final system.

contact_burden.contact_type: dry or wet electrode montage open

hardware_identity.rationale: EEG-specific four-channel AFE class with 250 samples/s support; montage, power state, and session schedule remain open.
exclusions: No final headband, electrode, or channel montage is selected.

hardware_identity.rationale: Manufacturer explicitly supports body/skin impedance and sequenced duty cycling; measurement settings remain open.
exclusions: The low-power potentiostat current is not used as active BioZ measurement power.
